name: Summerland Bank
legalName: Regional Australia Bank Ltd, trading as Summerland Bank (formerly Summerland Financial Services Limited / Summerland Credit Union)

notes.value: Summerland Bank's branch and service footprint is the Northern Rivers region of NSW and South East Queensland (branches at Ballina, Bangalow, Casino, The Pines Elanora, Evans Head, Grafton, Kingscliff, Kyogle, Lismore and Nimbin). No lending geography restriction is published, but the bank describes itself as "the people's bank, serving our local community" and no statement of national lending was found.
notes.note: Recorded as context only, not as a policy rule. Page carries no publication date; as-at is the date it was read.

maxLoanTermYears.note: "Maximum Loan Term — 30 years" on the Basic Home Loan, Premium Home Loan and Eco Home Loan comparison rows. Page carries no publication date; as-at is the date it was read.

guarantorConditions.value: "Secure Start" family guarantor product for first home buyers. Guarantors must be close family members, must own property in Australia and meet eligibility criteria. A guarantor offers part of their property as security; the borrower can "borrow up to 100% of the purchase price (plus costs)" and avoid LMI. Guarantees are commonly limited to around 20% of the loan at the outset, and the guarantor's security is typically released once the loan-to-value ratio reaches 80% (subject to a formal review and approval).

notes.value: Summerland lends through brokers, but access is restricted: "At Summerland we work with a select group of Brokers... Our broker partners are Regional Finance Solutions, North Coast Lending, Outsource Financial and Westlawn... Accreditation is offered through Regional Finance Services, North Coast Lending, Outsource Financial and Westlawn." A broker outside those four groups cannot be accredited directly. Broker support contacts are published (Chief Customer Officer Kylie Millwood; Broker Liaison Officer Malcolm Baker, brokersupport@summerland.com.au; BDM Michael Dudink). Advertised-rate eligibility conditions on the public rate table give a minimum new loan amount of $150,000 (and $500,000 for one tier) at a maximum LVR of 60% — these are pricing conditions for the headline rate, NOT the product's minimum loan amount or maximum LVR.
notes.note: Page carries no publication date; as-at is the date it was read.

gaps: Summerland Bank merged with Regional Australia Bank on 1 July 2026 and is now issued by Regional Australia Bank Ltd (ABN 21 087 650 360, ACL 241167) trading as Summerland Bank. As at the merger date banking systems were not connected and the brands continued to operate separately, so policy may diverge from the 'regional-australia-bank' record for some time.

Summerland publishes no Target Market Determinations online — the website states 'Target market determination available on request at our branches', so the TMD route used for other lenders in this tranche is unavailable.
No credit policy guide, servicing buffer, floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, HEM basis or credit-card assessment rate is published.
No maximum LVR (owner-occupied or investment), maximum LVR without LMI, or LMI provider is published.
No minimum or maximum loan amount is published (the $150,000 / $500,000 figures on the rate table are headline-rate eligibility conditions only).
No published income, employment tenure, credit history, security or residency policy.

Broker accreditation is only available via four named partners (Regional Finance Solutions, North Coast Lending, Outsource Financial, Westlawn) — confirm whether the NextKey/Springboard aggregator is one of these before treating Summerland as reachable.
